amends: collection.per_decision_point_records -- designates the regression target that the frozen protocol omitted

state_at_amendment.Q_psi: DOES NOT EXIST -- no scorer has been fitted
state_at_amendment.why_this_matters: an amendment written after a gate result would be a rescue. This one is written before the estimator it governs exists.

THE_AMENDMENT.target: Q_psi(o, a1, a2, p) regresses E[ terminal win margin | o, a, p ]
THE_AMENDMENT.definition: terminal_win_margin = blue_score - red_score at episode termination
THE_AMENDMENT.orientation: blue is ALWAYS the evaluated policy's team; red is ALWAYS the scripted opponent. Therefore positive margin ALWAYS means better for the evaluated policy. No per-pole sign flip is applied to the target itself.
THE_AMENDMENT.support_note: support is -2..+3 on train branch rows, not symmetric. The distribution is concentrated at 0 and +1. Recorded now so it cannot be described differently later.
THE_AMENDMENT.continuation_semantics: UNCHANGED -- teacher-consistent (branch A continues under pi_A, branch B under pi_B). The margin is the terminal margin of that continuation.
THE_AMENDMENT.sole_target: terminal win margin is the ONLY regression target. No auxiliary target is blended in.

why_margin_rather_than_win_flag.reason: margin preserves information that a 0/1 collapse discards, while remaining tied to game outcome rather than reward shaping
why_margin_rather_than_win_flag.win_flag_role: PRESPECIFIED SECONDARY CALIBRATION DIAGNOSTIC, designated now, not an alternative target selectable later
why_margin_rather_than_win_flag.explicit_prohibition: if win margin fails Gate 0B, the win flag MUST NOT be substituted as the target and the gate MUST NOT be re-run against it. That would be exactly the prohibited 'changed estimator' move.

monte_carlo_return.reason: training-only diagnostics show it is oriented AGAINST the strategic payoff ordering on both poles (LCB95 -1.2845 on A, -1.5394 on B). It is an optimisation signal containing reward shaping, not the payoff construct SPPPO exists to preserve.
monte_carlo_return.retained_as: telemetry and provenance only; it remains in the collected shards and is not deleted

EFFECTIVE_SAMPLE_SIZE_CAVEAT.rule: the scorer's statistical unit is the EPISODE/SEED, not the state
EFFECTIVE_SAMPLE_SIZE_CAVEAT.why: for plain trajectories, hundreds of states within one episode share a single terminal margin. The ~120k plain state rows are NOT ~120k independent payoff examples.
EFFECTIVE_SAMPLE_SIZE_CAVEAT.what_the_state_count_does_buy: representation learning -- many states help the encoder learn (o,a,p) structure
EFFECTIVE_SAMPLE_SIZE_CAVEAT.carries_into: scorer validation and calibration reporting must be expressed in these units; no report may quote a state count as if it were an independent sample size
EFFECTIVE_SAMPLE_SIZE_CAVEAT.plain_row_join: plain rows carry only plain_return in the shards. Terminal margin for a plain row is joined episode-level from seed_summaries by (seed, policy, pole), producing one shared label across that episode's states.

GATE_0B_UNCHANGED.statement: nothing seen in the target diagnostic alters Gate 0B in any respect

contrasts.d_A(o): V_hat(o, pi_A, A) - V_hat(o, pi_B, A)
contrasts.d_B(o): V_hat(o, pi_B, B) - V_hat(o, pi_A, B)

GATE_0B_UNCHANGED.bootstrap_unit: SEED, resampling seeds and retaining ALL branch points of each selected seed
GATE_0B_UNCHANGED.calibration: must hold PER policy/pole cell, not merely in aggregate
GATE_0B_UNCHANGED.if_fails: STOP. SPPPO is not built. No target substitution, no data growth, no re-run.

unchanged_by_this_amendment: scorer FORM Q_psi(o,a1,a2,p) = b + u^T e(a1) + v^T e(a2) + e(a1)^T M e(a2)
analytic expectation V_hat = b + u^T mu_1 + v^T mu_2 + mu_1^T M mu_2
policy identity remains PROHIBITED as a scorer input feature
